node.title: Ecosystem Positioning
node.summary: Contenido de la fuente: Agentic Architecture for staying situated as the ecosystem changes · Mathematical and functional plausibility · Hypothesis and traceability — start here.

relations: Participant-local positioning offers a later architectural comparison for distributed operational intelligence without presuming one global controller or shared objective.
La experiencia distribuida es antecedente de preguntas, no demostración de que el corredor operara esta arquitectura de 2026.
